title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #11 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is a heavy najasa such as dog saliva cleaned? (1 mark)
   A. Do nothing
   B. Wipe with dry cloth
   C. Sprinkle water once
   D. Wash seven times, once with soil

2. Which of these is NOT a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Blood that flows
   B. Vomit
   C. Stool
   D. Human sweat

3. Which water cannot be used to purify? (1 mark)
   A. Well water
   B. Clean rain water
   C. Tap water
   D. Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa

4. How many times do we usually wash each part in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Ten
   C. Once only for all
   D. Twenty

5. Which of these is recommended before going to sleep? (1 mark)
   A. Make wudhu
   B. Skip prayer
   C. Eat a big meal
   D. Shout

6. Which of these breaks wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Passing wind
   B. Sweating
   C. Talking
   D. Eating

7. Which of these can help find the Qibla? (1 mark)
   A. The colour of the sky
   B. The size of the mosque
   C. A compass or Qibla app
   D. The noise from the road

8. Why must clothes and the prayer place be clean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a game
   B. Purity is a condition of prayer
   C. It is not needed
   D. It saves money

9. To which sides do we turn for taslim? (1 mark)
   A. Backwards
   B. Only forward
   C. Up
   D. Right, then left

10. What should a person do if unable to stand for obligatory prayer because of illness? (1 mark)
   A. Pray later in the year
   B. Wait until well
   C. Pray sitting
   D. Skip the prayer

11. Which is the correct order in one rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Sitting, standing, bowing
   B. Ruku, Fatiha, sujud
   C. Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   D. Sujud, ruku, Fatiha

12. What does the Qur'an say about everything in the heavens and earth? (1 mark)
   A. They glorify Allah
   B. They are silent
   C. They ignore Him
   D. They are useless

13. The Prophet said those who show mercy will be shown mercy by (1 mark)
   A. A friend
   B. The government
   C. The Most Merciful
   D. The teacher

14. What is assertiveness in dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   B. Shouting
   C. Insulting others
   D. Copying everyone

15. What should we say when dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Bismillah
   C. Goodbye
   D. Amin

16. Why should you tell a parent if something online makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. It is not important
   B. It wastes their time
   C. They will laugh
   D. They can protect you

17. Which of these is a positive use of the internet? (1 mark)
   A. Meeting strangers
   B. Watching harmful videos
   C. Finding information for a school project with permission
   D. Bullying

18. What does Qur'an 62:10 tell us after prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Stay at home
   B. Beg
   C. Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty
   D. Stop working

19. What is "income"? (1 mark)
   A. Debt
   B. A prayer
   C. A gift
   D. Money earned from work

20. Which is a good way to help someone who cannot work? (1 mark)
   A. Give zakah and sadaqah
   B. Insult them
   C. Avoid them
   D. Ignore them

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how to clean a medium najasa on a mat. (3 marks)

22. Describe how to clean a place licked by a dog. (3 marks)

23. Explain what integrity means when using a phone. (3 marks)

24. Define wudhu and state its intention. (2 marks)

25. Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya. (3 marks)

26. Explain the rule when you are unsure whether wudhu broke. (3 marks)

27. What happened to the woman who did not feed her cat? (3 marks)

28. Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health. (4 marks)

29. How should a Muslim treat dogs even though their saliva is heavy najasa? (3 marks)

30. Name three types of media and give one example of each. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Wash seven times, once with soil
   This is the method for heavy najasa.

2. D — Human sweat
   Sweat is pure.

3. D — Water changed in colour, smell or taste by najasa
   Its purity has been lost.

4. A — Three
   The Sunnah is three times.

5. A — Make wudhu
   The Prophet told Al-Bara ibn Azib to do this.

6. A — Passing wind
   Anything from the front or back passage breaks wudhu.

7. C — A compass or Qibla app
   A compass helps find north.

8. B — Purity is a condition of prayer
   A valid prayer needs purity.

9. D — Right, then left
   We greet to the right and left.

10. C — Pray sitting
   Islam gives ease.

11. C — Fatiha, ruku, rising, sujud, sitting, sujud
   Tartib means this order.

12. A — They glorify Allah
   All creation praises Allah.

13. C — The Most Merciful
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

14. A — Politely standing by how you dress because of faith
   You calmly explain.

15. B — Bismillah
   Say Bismillah for good acts.

16. D — They can protect you
   Adults can help.

17. C — Finding information for a school project with permission
   Learning is good.

18. C — Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty
   Work and pray.

19. D — Money earned from work
   Income is what we earn.

20. A — Give zakah and sadaqah
   Islam encourages charity.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove the substance, pour water until the colour, smell and taste have gone, then dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for removal, 1 mark for washing until traces go, 1 mark for drying.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash seven times with water, one washing being mixed with clean soil, then rinse and dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seven washings, 1 mark for soil once, 1 mark for rinsing.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Doing the right thing even when nobody sees, because Allah sees and angels record. For example not cheating or copying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for Allah sees, 1 mark for example.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wudhu is washing certain parts of the body with water to prepare for prayer. The intention is made in the heart.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for definition and 1 mark for intention.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: If you were sure you made wudhu and only doubt it broke, you remain in wudhu, because certainty is not removed by doubt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for staying in wudhu, 1 mark for certainty, 1 mark for the example.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: She tied the cat and did not feed it or let it find food. She was punished because of this. It teaches us that cruelty to animals is a sin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for the punishment, 1 mark for the lesson.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kindly, without cruelty, giving them food and water, and only being careful to avoid their saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for not cruel, 1 mark for careful with saliva.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Print: newspaper; broadcast: radio; internet: video website.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each type with example.
